description: Rebuild n=32/64/128 as fully resident SM100 batched kernels: pack independent matrices per CTA or warpgroup, replace per-thread row arrays and cross-matrix barriers with subgroup-local POTRF panels, TMA/vectorized triangular I/O, and tcgen05/TMEM rank-k updates. Preserve fresh-input correctness and the existing larger-shape dispatches.

Replace n64 per-thread row arrays and CTA-wide barriers with four shared-resident 64-thread groups using named subgroup barriers; remote launch failed because the new kernel had not yet received the dynamic shared-memory opt-in attribute.

Run the corrected four-way shared-resident n64 subgroup kernel. Validation and fresh-input guard passed; full-grid metric 777.520 us, with n64 at 60.281 us (overall regression versus 751.039 us parent).
Collapse each resident n64 matrix to one warp with two rows per lane and warp-local shared synchronization. Validation passed; n64 measured 73.497 us and full-grid metric 797.285 us.

Restore the parent n64 path and pack eight independent warp-resident n32 matrices per CTA. Validation passed; n32 measured 17.886 us, n64 21.186 us, and the noisy full-grid metric was a run-low 733.122 us versus 751.039 us baseline.

Pack sixteen n32 matrices per CTA using opt-in dynamic shared storage. Validation passed; target cells n32=18.081 us, n64=21.191 us, n128=56.123 us; full-grid metric 737.400 us. Larger packing further slowed n32 versus 8-way 17.886 us and observed parent 4-way about 16.4 us.

Replace n128 WMMA kernel with one-CTA SM100 MathDx 64x64 POTRF/TRSM/half-rankk/POTRF pipeline and restore parent n32 packing. Dense n128 passed at scaled residual 7.73, but cond5 spectrum produced NaN/Inf after the single half-precision rank-k update; add compensated residual products next.

Add high/residual FP16 split and four FP32-accumulating SM100 MathDx rank-k products to the resident n128 two-panel pipeline. All official tests and guard passed; target cells n32=16.381 us, n64=21.177 us, n128=58.382 us; full-grid metric 728.770 us. n128 regressed versus parent WMMA ~56.1 us despite aggregate run-low.

Remove the second-order residual-square SM100 rank-k while retaining high product and both first-order cross corrections. Validation passed; target cells n32=16.351 us, n64=21.221 us, n128=57.558 us; full-grid metric 734.346 us. Saved 0.824 us on n128 versus four-product variant but remained above retained WMMA ~56.1 us.

Compute one H^T R SM100 rank-k into the dead FP32 panel buffer and fold it symmetrically in shared memory instead of launching both cross products. Validation passed; target cells n32=16.427 us, n64=21.235 us, n128=63.385 us; full-grid metric 794.835 us. The beta-zero output plus transposed shared fold cost 5.827 us versus direct two-cross accumulation.

Replace explicit n128 cross products with two direct symmetric SM100 updates: weighted H^T H and scaled S^T S correction (scale 8). Validation passed with cond5 residual 0.934; target cells n32=16.536 us, n64=21.365 us, n128=61.448 us; full-grid metric 767.912 us. This two-MMA formulation measured slower than three direct products in a high-noise run.

Replace n64 packed row-array kernel with one shared-resident SM100 MathDx 64x64 POTRF CTA per matrix and restore retained n128. Official validation passed, including cond5 cases, but the required full-grid Modal benchmark emitted no result for 2351 seconds and was terminated after exceeding recorded and task timeouts; no target metric available.

Bounded retry of validated direct resident SM100 n64 commit after the prior infrastructure timeout. Target cells n32=16.414 us, n64=33.770 us, n128=56.128 us; full-grid metric 769.017 us. Direct one-CTA MathDx n64 regressed 12.5 us versus retained packed n64 ~21.2 us.

Restored best validated brief donor cfca421c7172a4dfcea935e5920acbbabc9babd9. Measured target cells n32=16.351 us, n64=21.221 us, n128=57.558 us and full-grid=734.346 us; the n128 three-product SM100 MathDx pipeline saved 0.824 us versus its four-product predecessor but remained above retained WMMA near 56.1 us. Other measured variants: n64 named-group 60.281 us, one-warp n64 73.497 us, direct MathDx n64 33.770 us, n32 8-way 17.886 us, n32 16-way 18.081 us, n128 four-product 58.382 us, cross-fold 63.385 us, scaled-square 61.448 us. The first direct half n128 update failed cond5; high/residual corrections passed all tests. Keep the search moving: open directions include a true CuTe tcgen05/TMEM kernel that retains the n128 Schur accumulator in TMEM across correction products, 32-wide panel factor/TRSM with TMA-staged packed matrices, a multi-matrix warpgroup n64 design with subgroup epochs rather than library POTRF, and BF16x9 or TF32 residual decompositions that need only one native MMA sequence.
